title: Immersive Mini Golf Experience in Boston
includes: Each ticket includes a link to book parking at a 60% discount!
Use of equipment - golf balls, score cards, and putters
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: The "revolutionary" mini golf experience is now open indoors at the historic Faneuil Hall Marketplace! Embark on a cross-country road trip without ever leaving Boston's North End. With 18 vibrant holes inspired by iconic US landmarks and landscapes, Putt Across America is WICKED FUN for golfers of all ages. Make stops at iconic landmarks, national parks, and historical moments including the Boston Tea Party, Niagara Falls, The Alamo, The Grand Canyon, and more!
